text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"We're aiming for the top, no half measures.
I'll crush every strong rival out there—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I'll prove that I'm the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
